acceptance.given: The FR-8 valid-case inputs use an isolated missing-side fixture, with every non-fixture input held constant.

oracle.expected: The aggregate evaluation rejects the valid case and reports a rejection attributable to the missing side.
forbidden: The aggregate is accepted despite one side being missing.
Non-fixture inputs differ between the missing-side case and its control.
oracle.observable: The evaluator result and isolated-fixture comparison are captured during the behavior verification phase.

acceptance.then: The aggregate reaches the reject state and the evidence shows that only the required side was removed.
acceptance.when: Run the FR-8 valid-case evaluation against the missing-side fixture and inspect its aggregate status and comparison evidence.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the isolated FR-8 valid-case missing-side fixture; before implementation, the evaluator must fail to reject the aggregate or fail to attribute rejection to the missing side.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make FR-8 valid-case evaluation reject an aggregate when one required side is missing while preserving all other inputs.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent schema change; rollback restores the prior replay evaluation behavior.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The missing-side fixture produces an aggregate rejection with a missing-side reason, and the control comparison confirms all other inputs remain unchanged.
